bytes: the real decimal parser reads the text and 0x3750350 runs in mode 2: half even to six places, any further digits accepted; 0.0000015 moves 2 raw units

subject: exponent and separators
bytes: the parser takes 1e3, 1E3, 1e-3, 1_000, 1_ and 1.e2; it refuses a leading underscore

subject: negative text
reference lead: negative value carried into a signed amount
bytes: a negative that rounds to a nonzero whole is tag 0xa8; one that rounds to zero is amount 0 and the action succeeds with no move

subject: user amount cap
reference lead: parsed.usd >= 0x0ccc... gives status 319 on the user path
bytes: no such compare on the user path; the 100 times overflow refuses above floor(u64::MAX/100) with 0xf7, well below that cap, and 0x3750350 refuses above 2^63-2 with 0xa8. Only the system handler compares with 0x0ccc...

subject: three part text
bytes: the split is a split-n of 2: a second separator stays inside the address text and gives 0xb6; the 0x131 branch for other part counts is not reached
case: text second separator stays in the address

subject: 0x131 status
bytes: only the empty text reaches it; a bad amount is tag 0xac from the parser

subject: amount before address
bytes: the address is parsed first; 0xb6 hides a bad amount
case: text sub bad address before bad amount

subject: space before the separator
bytes: the left part is trimmed at its end for all Unicode white space, only when a separator is present

subject: address text
bytes: lower case 0x only; extra leading bytes must be the character 0; errors text 'string too short to be Address' or the leading pad text
